query: INSERT INTO public.attention_items (id, tenant_id, module_id, kind, ref_type, ref_id, payload, severity, dedupe_key) VALUES ($1, $2, 'core', $3, 'outbox', $4, $5, 'high', $6) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, dedupe_key) DO UPDATE SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, resolved_at = NULL, resolved_by = NULL
